v1.triaged_only_if: Jev is confident on both questions: Q1 choice is NO_DECISION (-> triaged_no_decision) or EXCLUDED_REGIME (-> triaged_excluded), Q1 confidence >= 0.7, Q1 P(DECIDES) < 0.15 and Q2 chain_duty < 0.3.
v1.why: Missing law is the costly error, so routing is deliberately asymmetric (brief, Step 4).

v2.triaged_only_if: As v1, plus: the section is not cited by a 4A/5A universe item; it is not a definition or applicability section in a unit with a stated rule; and triaged_excluded is allowed only inside a regime unit (RS/RC routing units). Q2 threshold lowered from 0.3 to 0.10.
v2.why: v1 missed 14 of 315 gold positives (calibration.json). Every miss is caught by v2: LLC Law 206, RPL 441-c, STT 305, SCPA 1305/1802, Admin. Code 27-2097 are cited by the independent reviewers' universes; 24 CFR 982.404 and RPL 232-b were marked EXCLUDED_REGIME outside a regime unit (the Housing Choice Voucher program is inside the aperture); 28 RCNY 1-01 is an applicability section in a unit with stated rules; GCN 35, RPL 212, RPL 442, Admin. Code 26-414 and 26-520 have chain_duty between 0.10 and 0.29.
